newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN SHARES EDGE UP AT START, BONDS SUPPORT.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN SHARES EDGE UP AT START, BONDS SUPPORT.

text.p: 0810 GMT - Belgian shares edge higher at the start in quiet trading after Thursday's holiday, supported by lower bond market yields but with low volumes seen exaggerating some buy/ask spreads.
* Huge Labour victory in U.K. general election having no impact on sentiment, dealers say, with focus on U.S. instead where jobs data due later.
* Bel-20 index up 3.57 points or 0.16 percent at 2,249.08.
